# Mutation-check TS gates in an archive copy with node_modules symlinked

<a id="body"></a>

## Body

Review worktrees have no node_modules. For a TS gate mutation: T=$(mktemp -d); git archive HEAD | tar -x -C $T/a; ln -s <main checkout>/node_modules $T/a/node_modules; mutate; nice -n 19 node_modules/.bin/vitest run <test>. Copy the built debug pij-rs into $T right after shared-build (another tree can swap it). The debug build reports '(unstamped)', so its --version can't prove which tree built it. Record $T and rm only that path at the end (F262).
